classification: execution-policy amendment (transport/accounting control plane); no scientific-protocol change

owner_approval.basis: standing blanket approval for in-phase amendments, granted in the owner's pickup message and reaffirmed by his 'go' for the successor canary under the same cap
owner_verbatim: Pickup work on this project where codex left off. I approve all future amendments to this phase
owner_approval.authority_note: The independent Codex consult bound below concurred this amendment stays within in-phase operational authority (same $60 aggregate cap, fresh-row execution preserved, no scientific gate changed) and does not require waking the owner. Anything beyond it (row reuse, cap increase, protocol/roster/gate change, main spend, or a further successor after an uncertainty-ceiling trip) exceeds this authority and requires the owner.

codex_consult.verdict_summary: Option A: amend the uncertain-spend invariant and redo all 960 gate rows under a fresh identity. Ceiling $1.00 per run (not $5). Rerun the paid one-seed harness under amended code. Refresh the price snapshot at manifest freeze. Keep the zero-fresh-ledger launch rule. No reuse of rows, caches, or rulings from any halted identity. No automatic successor if the ceiling trips.

defect_repaired.summary: The zero-uncertain launch validator was also applied per-pass, at resume, and at finalize, so the first billing-uncertain transport event after launch made the run unfinishable and unresumable while the in-run transport policy deliberately continued past such events.

policy.fresh_ledger_launch_rule: unchanged: a new run-local ledger must be genesis-only with exactly zero actual, uncertain, and open-reservation exposure
policy.live_ledger_rule: a live or resumed v4-binding ledger may hold terminal unknown_charge events; their full reserved cost stays booked as uncertain spend, counts against the aggregate cap, and must not exceed the per-run ceiling; open reservations, charged-malformed responses, and returned-model drift remain refusals
policy.dispatch_rule: before every provider dispatch the client requires run_uncertain + proposed_worst_case_reservation <= ceiling and aggregate actual + uncertain + open reservations + proposed <= $60 cap
policy.ceiling_trip_rule: reaching the ceiling halts the run fail-closed for owner review; no successor identity is minted without the owner
policy.final_report_rule: the successor canary report labels accounting PASS_CLEAN or PASS_CONSERVATIVE_UNCERTAIN, lists every unknown_charge event with its completing success attempt, and clusters uncertain events by experimental condition

science_unchanged.statement: Protocol, roster, prompts, seeds, token limits, transport pins, reviewer instructions, cell plan, and every analysis gate are unchanged. All 960 gate rows will be generated fresh under the new identity; the 48 preseeded transcripts remain fixed protocol inputs.

non_claims: This amendment approves the execution-policy change and creation of a fresh successor identity.
Paid inference still requires a separate authorization containing the exact successor run identity.
This amendment does not authorize main spend, row or cache reuse, or any further successor after an uncertainty-ceiling trip.
